name: @datagrok/pmxstudio
description: PMX Studio Preclinical: de novo design of xenograft and syngeneic efficacy studies from a curated atlas of historical controls

properties.name: labGroup
properties.description: The Datagrok group whose members may change the lab's outlier rules for everyone (Administrators always can)

properties.name: outlierRules
properties.description: The lab's outlier rules for the study table (JSON, written from the table's Rules dialog; empty: the defaults)

properties.name: humaneLimit
properties.description: The lab's humane limit for the tumor volume (mm³), from its approved protocol: a new plan or study starts from it (empty: 1500)
